name: The First Conduit Threshold
description: State after 'Trust Before Truth'. The Network is awake, real, constrained - and STAGED: C1 indeterminate, so DN 4.1 holds commitment open; its authority over the wider World is unapplied and its pending deltas accumulate unspent (DN 3.1). The rule 'recognition -> amplification authority' is withheld and logged. The fallow crossing is restored as an independently reachable route (not a region). The promise survives at its clarified original scope, presented from the reference record. Three memory traces; the World knows where a promise ends, and pays staging's coherence cost rather than commit on stipulation.

coherence.notes: Net +0.04 over the Trace open: the legibility of the boundary. The bloom's 0.55 was genuinely reached under the measurement then in use and stands in the record; its meaning was corrected, not erased - that measurement conflated local alignment and reduced diversity with global coherence (observation #5 evidence; append-only discipline applied to a number). Staging's ongoing coherence cost is carried knowingly (DN 4.1). Resonance Gate approaching - genuinely unknown whether nearer or farther than before; the bloom's approach was artifact of the conflation.
